alms.abilityText: Once per turn: If you have no Treasures in play, gain a card costing up to $4$4.

ball.abilityText: Take your –$1 token. Gain 2 cards each costing up to $4.

bonfire.abilityText: Trash up to 2 Coppers you have in play.

borrow.abilityText: Once per turn: +1 Buy. If your –1 Card token isn't on your deck, put it there and +$1.

expedition.abilityText: Draw 2 extra cards for your next hand.

plan.abilityText: Move your Trashing token to an Action Supply pile. (When you gain a card from that pile, you may trash a card from your hand.)

ferry.abilityText: Move your –$2 cost token to an Action Supply pile. (Cards from that pile cost $2 less on your turns.)

inheritance.abilityText: Once per game: Set aside a non-Command non-Duration Action card from the Supply costing up to $4. Move your Estate token to it. (During your turns, Estates are also Command Actions with "Play the card with your Estate token, leaving it there.")

pilgrimage.abilityText: Once per turn: Turn your Journey token over (it starts face up); then if it's face up, choose up to 3 differently named cards you have in play and gain a copy of each.

lost-arts.abilityText: Move your +1 Action token to an Action Supply pile. (When you play a card from that pile, you first get +1 Action.)

mission.abilityText:
Take an extra turn after this one (but not a 3rd turn in a row), during which you can't buy cards.
(You can still buy Events.)

pathfinding.abilityText: Move your +1 Card token to an Action Supply pile. (When you play a card from that pile, you first get +1 Card.)

quest.abilityText: You may discard an Attack, two Curses, or six cards. If you do, gain a Gold.

raid.abilityText: Gain a Silver per Silver you have in play. Each other player puts their –1 Card token on their deck.

save.abilityText: Once per turn: +1 Buy. Set aside a card from your hand, and put it into your hand at end of turn (after drawing).

scouting-party.abilityText:
+1 Buy
Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Discard 3 and put the rest back in any order.

seaway.abilityText: Gain an Action card costing up to $4. Move your +1 Buy token to its pile. (When you play a card from that pile, you first get +1 Buy.)

trade.abilityText: Trash up to 2 cards from your hand. Gain a Silver per card you trashed.

training.abilityText: Move your +$1 token to an Action Supply pile. (When you play a card from that pile, you first get +$1.)

travelling-fair.abilityText:
+2 Buys
When you gain a card this turn, you may put it onto your deck.
